title: Developer Experience Platform That Engineering Leaders Trust | Faros

hero.headline: Engineer exceptional experiences
hero.subhead: Faros provides contextualized insight to help transform with AI, improve productivity, and delight engineers.

sections.heading: Outcomes we deliver — build a world-class engineering engine
sections.body: Accelerate velocity/efficiency (rank and fix bottlenecks), turn feedback into action (correlate surveys with metrics), empower team autonomy (self-serve metrics), optimize DevEx ROI.

sections.heading: How DevEx and platform engineers use Faros
sections.body: Unify engineering data across bespoke CI/CD and on-prem; bridge sentiment and systems (overlay qualitative feedback with telemetry); isolate systemic friction (inner/outer loops + sentiment); benchmark productivity at scale on DORA/SPACE/DevEx/Stanford frameworks.

sections.heading: What you get
sections.body: Holistic Benchmarking, hundreds of metrics (heatmaps, adoption trackers, alerts), self-serve analytics (LLM-powered exploration, Slack/Teams answers), extensible data model, automated AI insights, enterprise-grade security.

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. Role/solution page for DevEx + Platform Engineering. Strongly corroborates persona:maya's 'empower the team, never rank it' and 'developers want help not surveillance' — page leads with team autonomy and sentiment+telemetry, not individual ranking. Reinforces principle:empower-not-police. Mostly recombines the Developer Productivity capability for this audience; no new node proposed beyond corroboration. Testimonial: Ben Cochran, VP Developer Enablement, Autodesk.
